treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg once daily and titrate to a maximum of 10 mg daily over 4–6 weeks to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg, in line with NICE NG136 first‑line recommendation for essential hypertension. No drug‑drug interactions with current acetaminophen or ferrous sulfate. Verify renal function, serum potassium, and pregnancy status before initiation. Provide lifestyle advice (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight loss, limit alcohol, smoking cessation) and arrange follow‑up labs and BP checks as per guideline monitoring.
